text: vv shall load and lint requirements.
vv shall trace requirements to checks and artifacts.
vv shall derive verification status and coverage from evidence.
vv shall track technical performance measures.
vv shall compute earned value earned only by verification.
vv shall report a project folder as JSON.
vv shall measure itself.
load shall report bad-id, unknown-parent, bad-method and missing-acceptance, sorted by id then code in code-unit order.
load shall report duplicate-id once per repeated id.
acceptance: Three copies of one id give one problem.

text: load shall report every member of a parent cycle and no requirement that only hangs off one.
load shall apply bad-method and missing-acceptance to leaves only.
acceptance: A parent with no method and no acceptance raises nothing; a requirement whose parent is itself is still a leaf and gets both checks (D21).

text: lint shall flag placeholder values, vague wording, and-or and a missing shall, as sorted distinct codes, matching whole words in any case.
trace shall map every requirement to the sorted distinct ids that verify and implement it, and list dangling link indices.
trace shall list as orphans the leaves nothing verifies, in plain string order.
status shall classify a leaf as verified, failed, partial or unverified from the latest result of each check on or before asOf.
acceptance: Ties on a date go to the later entry.

text: status shall roll a parent up over its shall children, or over all children when none is shall.
coverage shall count leaf statuses and give verified over total, 0 with no leaves.
tpm shall give current, margin, status against the risk band, and objectiveMet, using only history on or before asOf.
acceptance: Margin equal to the band is met.

text: tpm shall give the least-squares slope per day and the first date on or after asOf on which the fitted line is past the threshold.
tpm shall not count a fitted line that lies on the threshold as past it, and shall give a null projectedBreach for a crossing after 9999-12-31.
acceptance: Oracle-found case gives 2031-04-07; a 1e-12 slope gives null without throwing.
rationale: README D16, D17: float noise moved a breach by a day, and a near-zero slope crashed the report.

text: earned shall compute PV per work package by clamped linear spread from day 1 at the earliest start, and AC from actuals on or before asOf.
earned shall earn value only for requirements verified at asOf, and derive SV, CV, SPI and CPI with null on division by zero.
acceptance: A later fail removes earned value.

text: earned shall compute earned schedule, AT and SPIt as SPEC M5 defines them.
The CLI shall print one JSON object with asOf, problems, lint, coverage, orphans, status, tpms and evm, defaulting asOf to the latest date in the data.
The CLI shall treat a missing file as empty and give evm null without a plan.
acceptance: An empty folder reports nothing and dates itself today.

text: The CLI shall report a parent cycle as a problem and still print the report, with every cycle member unverified.
rationale: SPEC promises M2-M6 no cycles, but a real project finds its cycles through the CLI; before D18 it overflowed the stack instead.

text: With --check, the CLI shall exit 3 when there is any load problem, failed leaf, breached TPM, or coverage below --min-coverage, and shall print the same JSON either way.
rationale: Not in SPEC (D20). A project gating merges on vv needs an exit code, not a person reading JSON.

text: This folder shall hold requirements and links for vv with no load problems, no orphans, no dangling links and at least 12 leaves.
node test.mjs shall write evidence.json with a pass or fail for each check it ran.
acceptance: evidence.json lists every check, dated today.

text: vv shall agree with an independent build of M1 to M6 on random inputs.
rationale: Hand-worked cases only test the cases someone thought of.
